subject.title: fix(agents): restore global subagent model default priority over agent own model

question: Should isolated cron and shared fallback selection adopt the global-subagent-default-first precedence already used by native subagent spawning?
rationale: The helper correction is technically sound and documentation-aligned, but it intentionally changes the effective provider/model for some existing named-agent cron configurations.

options.title: Align all subagent paths
